title: feat: add creator prompt templates
body:
## Summary
Adds three one-click creator templates (`Product demo`, `Character intro`, `Explainer`) that prefill the full generation setup: image prompt, negative prompt, motion prompt, narration, style, aspect ratio, and image option count.

This gives users a guided starting point before spending time/credits on image options, while leaving every field editable after a template is applied.

Validation: `npm --prefix /home/ubuntu/repos/image-video-voice-app run lint:web`, `npm --prefix /home/ubuntu/repos/image-video-voice-app/apps/web run typecheck`, `npm --prefix /home/ubuntu/repos/image-video-voice-app run build:web`, and `/home/ubuntu/repos/image-video-voice-app/apps/api/.venv/bin/pytest /home/ubuntu/repos/image-video-voice-app/apps/api/tests -q` all pass.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/7f60b6b552fe4c6cb48c9867bb7c036d
Requested by: @seeincodes
